question.text: Chapter 9.7.2 requires the Sponsor/Manager of Chambal Managed Futures Fund to appoint a custodian for a Cat III scheme:

answer.text: Within 30 days after the first investment of the scheme.
Prior to the date of first investment of the scheme.
Only after SEBI explicitly directs appointment.
Only if the scheme invests in listed equity.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.7.2 concludes: 'The Sponsor/Manager needs to appoint custodian for a scheme of an AIF prior to the date of first investment of the scheme.' This pre-investment appointment locks in safekeeping and reporting from day one. The Trap: Options A and C introduce post-investment or SEBI-triggered timelines that misread the regulation. Option D wrongly limits custodian need to equity. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the pre-investment appointment rule. XIX-D also tests it for Cat I/II.
